en: I went quiet when the teacher entered.
I did not keep quiet in the meeting yesterday.
You went quiet when you heard the news.
You did not keep quiet at all tonight.
You (f.) went quiet when Dad entered.
You (f.) did not stop talking yesterday.
He went quiet when he saw the police.

lat: ma sketsh mn l-hedra f d-dar
en: He did not stop talking at home.
The girl went quiet when her mother entered.
She did not keep quiet until we arrived.
We went quiet when the movie started.
We did not stay quiet at all on the road.
You (pl.) went quiet when the teacher came.
You (pl.) did not stop laughing yesterday.
The boys went quiet when the match started.

ar: هما ما سكتوش حتى جا الاستاذ
en: They did not quiet down until the teacher came.
I always keep quiet when I am angry.
I do not keep silent about the truth.
You always keep quiet in the classroom.

lat: nta ma katsketsh ga3 f d-dar
en: You do not keep quiet at all at home.
You (f.) always keep quiet when there are guests.
You (f.) don't keep quiet on the phone.
He always keeps quiet at work.
The boy does not stop crying.

lat: hiya dima katsket f l-khedma dyalha
en: She always keeps quiet at her work.

lat: ma katsketsh mn l-hedra kul nhar
ar: ما كتسكتش من الهضرة كل نهار
en: She does not stop talking every day.
We always keep quiet in the cinema.
We do not stay silent about injustice.
You (pl.) keep quiet when the teacher speaks.

lat: ntuma ma katsektush ga3 f l-biru
en: You (pl.) do not keep quiet at all in the office.
The children go quiet when they go to sleep.
They do not stop shouting.
I am going to keep quiet now because I am tired.

ar: ما غاديش نسكت على هاد الشي
en: I am not going to keep quiet about this.
You are going to shut up or I am going to leave.

lat: nta ma ghadish tsket ga3 l-yum
ar: نتا ما غاديش تسكت كاع اليوم
en: You are not going to shut up at all today.

lat: nti ghadi tsekti daba wlla la
ar: نتي غادي تسكتي دابا ولا لا
en: You (f.) are going to be quiet now or not?

ar: نتي ما غاديش تسكتي حتى تكملي
en: You (f.) are not going to keep quiet until you finish.

lat: huwa ghadi ysket fash yshuf l-khbar
ar: هو غادي يسكت فاش يشوف الخبار
en: He is going to go quiet when he sees the news.

ar: هو ما غاديش يسكت على حقو
en: He is not going to stay silent about his right.

lat: hiya ghadi tsket fash yji baba
ar: هي غادي تسكت فاش يجي بابا
en: She is going to go quiet when Dad comes.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tsket 3la had l-mushkil
ar: هي ما غاديش تسكت على هاد المشكل

ar: حنا غادي نسكتو فاش يبدا الفيلم
en: We are going to go quiet when the movie starts.

ar: حنا ما غاديش نسكتو على هاد الغلط
en: We are not going to stay silent about this mistake.

lat: ntuma ghadi tsektu fash ybda d-dars
ar: نتوما غادي تسكتو فاش يبدا الدرس
en: You (pl.) are going to be quiet when the lesson starts.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tsektu mn l-hedra
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تسكتو من الهضرة
en: You (pl.) are not going to stop talking.

lat: huma ghadi ysektu fash yweslu l d-dar
ar: هما غادي يسكتو فاش يوصلو للدار
en: They are going to go quiet when they reach the house.

lat: huma ma ghadish ysektu 7tta yakhdu l-flus
ar: هما ما غاديش يسكتو حتى ياخدو الفلوس
en: They are not going to stay quiet until they take the money.
